shell.moderatorEmpty: The moderation console is still being built. Comment, photo and report queues and the audit log are coming.

dashboard.title: Organisation dashboard
dashboard.intro: A quick look at your organisation. Every figure here links to the list it summarises.
dashboard.attendanceRateEmpty: No sessions have started yet to compute a rate.

proposals.title: Review proposals
proposals.intro: Every proposal members have sent, waiting on your decision. Rejecting and requesting changes each need a written reason, which reaches the proposer.
proposals.empty: No proposals are waiting for review.
proposals.count: {count, plural, =0 {no proposals} one {one proposal} other {{value} proposals}}
proposals.age: {count, plural, =0 {arrived today} one {a day ago} other {{value} days ago}}
proposals.notesLabel: The proposer's notes for the admin
proposals.approveNote: Approving does not publish the session — scheduling and publishing are a separate act.
proposals.reasonLabel: The reason the proposer will read
proposals.reasonHint: Write it the way you would say it to them — it is all they will see of your decision.
proposals.reasonRequired: Write the reason first — no decision reaches a proposer without one.
proposals.failed: That decision could not be recorded — try again.
proposals.done: Your decision is recorded and has reached the proposer.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.intro: Where approved proposals become sessions, and where you create one directly when you need to.
sessions.readyIntro: Proposals you approved that have not become a session yet.
sessions.readyCount: {count, plural, =0 {no proposals} one {one proposal} other {{value} proposals}}
sessions.directIntro: A session with no proposal behind it. You choose the presenter, and they may decline, which returns it to draft.
sessions.presentersHint: Each is notified and each may decline.
sessions.scheduleNote: Creating sets no date and no place — scheduling and publishing come next.
sessions.moderatorIntro: Choose a session to open its attendance report.
sessions.failed: That session could not be created — try again.
sessions.invalid: Check the required fields: title, description and category.
sessions.cancelReasonHint: Everyone who reserved a seat sees this, and it stays on the session's page.
sessions.actionFailed: That action could not be carried out — try again.
sessions.cancelReasonRequired: Write the reason for cancelling first.

schedule.title: Schedule and publish
schedule.intro: Set the time, the place and the capacity, then publish. Publishing makes the session visible to members and opens booking.
schedule.whenHint: In the venue's own time zone, not your device's.
schedule.durationHint: The end time is worked out from this, and you can override it below.
schedule.endsHint: Leave empty to derive it from the duration.
schedule.venuePlaceholder: Choose one of your organisation's venues
schedule.customHint: A one-off venue is not added to your organisation's list.
schedule.capacityHint: Filled in from the venue's capacity; you can change it.
schedule.deadlineHint: Leave empty to use the session's start time.
schedule.languageHint: The language of the room, not of the interface.
schedule.published: Published. Members can see it now.
schedule.publishNote: Once published, members can see the session and book a seat.
schedule.incompleteTitle: Not ready to publish — still missing:
schedule.posterPending: The poster arrives with the designer in a later milestone and does not block publishing today.
schedule.failed: That could not be saved — try again.
schedule.invalid: Check the fields: a date, a time and a duration are required, plus a venue from the list or a one-off venue with a name and an address.

venues.title: Venues
venues.intro: Your organisation's rooms. Choosing one when scheduling fills in the capacity.
venues.noDeleteNote: A venue cannot be deleted, only deactivated, so past sessions can still say where they were held.
venues.timeZoneHint: Leave empty to follow the organisation's time zone.
venues.upcoming: {count, plural, =0 {no upcoming sessions} one {one upcoming session} other {{value} upcoming sessions}}
venues.seats: {count, plural, =0 {no seats} one {one seat} other {{value} seats}}
venues.failed: That could not be saved — try again.
venues.invalid: Check the fields: a name is required, and a map link must start with https.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Your organisation's session categories. Every proposal and session carries exactly one.
categories.noDeleteNote: A category cannot be deleted, only deactivated, so past sessions can still say what it was.
categories.sessionCount: {count, plural, =0 {no sessions} one {one session} other {{value} sessions}}
categories.failed: That could not be saved — try again.
categories.invalid: Check the fields: a name is required.

companies.title: Companies
companies.intro: Your group's companies. A member picks theirs from this list when completing their profile.
companies.noDeleteNote: A company cannot be deleted, only deactivated, so existing members can still say where they work.
companies.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {no members} one {one member} other {{value} members}}
companies.failed: That could not be saved — try again.
companies.invalid: Check the fields: a name is required.

members.title: Members and roles
members.intro: Every member of your organisation, their email address (visible to you only), and their role on the platform.
members.reasonLabel: The deactivation reason recorded in the audit log
members.reasonHint: The member never sees this reason; it stays in your organisation's audit log.

error.last_admin: The organisation cannot be left without an admin — assign another admin first.
error.not_an_admin: You no longer have admin access — reload the page.
error.member_not_found: That member could not be found.
error.stale_claims: Your session's data changed — reload the page and try again.
error.cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own membership.
error.failed: That action could not be carried out — try again.

attendance.title: Attendance report
attendance.attendanceRateEmpty: No confirmed reservations to compute a rate.
attendance.manualIntro: For a member who reserved but has not checked in, or who attended without a reservation. A reason is required and is recorded in the audit log.
attendance.manualNotOpen: Manual marking is available only while the session is running.
attendance.empty: No reservations and no check-ins yet.
attendance.ratingsNote: This view is audited: opening this section records a row in your organisation's audit log every time.

error.not_found: That session could not be found.
error.not_open: Manual marking is available only while the session is running.
error.member_not_found: That member could not be found.
error.presenter_cannot_check_in: A session's presenter does not check in to it.
error.unknown: That could not be recorded — try again.

moderation.photosTakedownIntro: Photos already hidden at a member's request, waiting on your review.
moderation.photosReportsIntro: Open reports on photos that have not been hidden yet. The photo stays visible until you decide.
